stages.name: startup
stages.expectation: subscriber READY and public health ready; establish first feature window

stages.name: continuous
stages.expectation: wall-clock simulation input; normal availability denominator

stages.name: publisher_stop
stages.expectation: no publisher; observe TTL expiry and UNKNOWN/rejection

stages.name: resume_duplicate
stages.expectation: resume same boot with controlled repeated identities; no repeated business side effects

stages.name: edge_restart
stages.expectation: restart owned edge only, preserve Journal/business DB and event identity

stages.name: new_boot
stages.expectation: new analysis window; inject a marked old-boot sample to check isolation

stages.name: shutdown
stages.expectation: stop owned input/processes; collect DB integrity, OPEN uniqueness and exit evidence

unresolved: Resolve and record loopback ports, broker path/hash/version and dependency lock before execution.
Verify TTL against the frozen runtime configuration; this plan does not inspect runtime config.
Validate existing owned-process backend and phase assertions against actual local MQTT after authorization.
Review captured resources, OS clocks, consumption latency and exit invariants against explicit budgets.
Define final coverage/latency/capacity thresholds before execution; no thresholds imply no PASS.
note: Offsets are a predeclared plan, not observed timestamps. A phase failure must remain in evidence; do not shift normal/fault denominators after failure.
